page.title: Walk the avatar by touch
page.lead: On a phone, tap Avatar: a joystick shows up in the corner of the scene. Drag up to walk, sideways to turn and let go to stop. Get close to a building and tap Enter or Information. With mouse and keyboard, nothing changes.
page.notesLabel: Notes (test: type e, i or h here)
page.notesPlaceholder: Type freely: shortcuts don't fire in this field
page.keysMove: W/S or ↑/↓: walk · A/D or ←/→: turn · C: Avatar ⇄ Orbital
page.keysInteract: Near a building: I info · E enter the room
page.keysHelp: H: student guide · Esc: close the open window
page.keysOrbital: Orbital: click or tap a building · drag rotates · Esc clears the selection
page.keysTouch: On touch: the Avatar button turns on the joystick · drag up to walk, sideways to turn · let go to stop
